subject: Access Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts — NDA gating & audit window clarification
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: auditor@brightaudit.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jan 2028 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well — I’m Daniel on the security team at FinSecure. We’re preparing our vendor due diligence for the coming quarter and would like access to Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report and a redacted controls narrative for our internal audit. Our procurement policy requires an executed NDA before privileged artifacts are shared.

Two quick clarifications to help scope our ask:
- Audit period required: do you have a Type II report covering any continuous 12-month period that includes 2027? Please confirm the exact start/end dates.
- If the full report takes time to release under NDA, would Redwood provide a limited excerpt or bridge confirmation of the controls status short-term?

I’ve attached our intake form (audit_request_form.xlsx) that lists the items we typically request. If you prefer, we can sign your standard mutual NDA.

Thanks — appreciated.

Daniel Park
Senior Security Analyst | FinSecure
compliance@finsecure.com

Attachments: audit_request_form.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jan 2028 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear note and the intake form. I’ve looped in Laura from Legal and Markus from Security to help with the NDA and the scope.

Next steps from our side:
1) I’m attaching a draft mutual NDA we typically use for privileged report sharing — Laura, can you take a look for any redlines? (file: FinSecure_NDA_draft_v1.pdf)
2) Markus, can you confirm the last Type II period we have available and whether we can provide a short controls summary ahead of the executed NDA?
3) Daniel, once we have an executed NDA we’ll provision access via a secure link (S3 expiring link) or DocuSign/DocShare depending on preference.

Timing: we should be able to turn around countersign within 2–3 business days if there are no major redlines, otherwise Laura will advise.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: FinSecure_NDA_draft_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Thanks Hannah — quick read-through. I summarized redline items below for visibility to FinSecure:
- Section 4 (Confidential Information): add carve-outs for obligated disclosures to regulators (standard).
- Section 7 (Return/Destruction): add 90-day retention window for evidence exchanged during onboarding (reasonable for audit artifacts).
- Section 10 (Liability): propose mutual limitation of liability (we marked as TBD).

Daniel — we can accept your standard NDA or proceed on this mutual draft with the minor edits above. If you prefer DocuSign, we’ll prepare the envelope once you confirm which NDA to sign.

I’m attaching a short notes file with proposed language so you can see the edits inline (redlined_nda_notes.txt).

LAURA BENNETT
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: redlined_nda_notes.txt
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jan 2028 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Hi all — appreciate the quick turnaround. We’re comfortable with the outlined redlines; legal can accept the 90-day retention window and the carve-outs. Please go ahead and prepare a DocuSign envelope with the mutual NDA (FinSecure is fine with mutual limitation language).

Regarding audit period: our internal checklist prefers a report that covers at least one full calendar year that includes 2027 (so e.g., 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 or 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31). If Redwood’s most recent Type II report ends 2026-09-30, will you provide a bridge confirmation that controls remained materially consistent through 2027? If a bridge letter is an option, please indicate the limited scope and whether it will be signed by your audit partner.

Thanks — happy to sign today once the DocuSign link is live.

Daniel
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jan 2028 08:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Daniel — quick operational note from Security. Our latest Type II report covers the period 2026-02-01 through 2027-01-31 (we moved our audit window last cycle; that’s why it doesn’t map exactly to calendar year).

Options we can offer under NDA:
- Full report access once NDA executed (standard).
- A signed controls confirmation letter (limited scope) that states the control status through 2027-06-30; this letter would be an internal confirmation and would be signed by our SOC auditor ONLY in narrowly scoped bridge cases — turnaround 3–5 business days after request.
- If you need a calendar-year Type II specifically, we can provide the 2026-02-01–2027-01-31 report and annotate the deviations in the audit window for your reviewers.

Hannah — I’ll provision the secure bucket path for the report once DocuSign is complete. Laura — please include the 90-day retention language in the NDA envelope.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finsecure.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jan 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Daniel — thanks for confirming. We’ve created the DocuSign envelope with the mutual NDA and included the 90-day retention item Laura noted. Link below:
https://app.docusign.com/uat/example-link

Workflow:
- Once executed by both parties we will: 1) provision temporary S3 access to the Type II report (2026-02-01 to 2027-01-31), 2) provide a short controls summary PDF, and 3) optionally issue the signed controls confirmation letter covering through 2027-06-30 if you require that extra assurance.

Please sign when convenient and let me know if you’d prefer the excerpt delivered instead of the full file initially.

—Hannah
Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference
